_comment: Disembedding distractor pools per target category. Source: runlogs/grasp_library_20260905/select (groups/disembedding__*.json, out/, test_instances.json, duplicates/verdicts.json) + the look-alike review in scripts/build_disembedding_pools.py. The compact form is the 'distractors' section of disembedding-0 in ispatialgym/assets/task_specs/task_custom_lists.json.

rules.same_category_pool: every disembedding model of the category with >= 1 AG-valid grasp except 'excluded' (V <= 1); the target itself and its look-alikes are removed at sampling time
rules.other_category_pool: same_category pools of the other members of the category's families (minus look-alikes of the target)
rules.lookalike_groups: models indistinguishable from the robot's initial view (~0.9 m, objects 20-130 px): exact duplicates and same-shape variants whose only difference is a small print / label or a subtle shade; never drawn as each other's distractors

packs.description: flat / small printed packs and cases

bottles.description: upright bottles, cans and pump dispensers

small_items.description: small tabletop items (cutlery, chips, blocks, rolls, mice, ...)
